properties.name: entur.jwt.jwk.health-indicator.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable the JWKs health indicator.

deprecation.reason: The JWKs health indicator is a standard Spring Boot health indicator.

properties.name: entur.jwt.flavours.keycloak.client-id
properties.description: Client id (i.e. key in the access-token claim 'resource_access') of the client whose roles are mapped to authorities (with prefix 'ROLE_'). Normally the client id of this resource server. If not set, no client roles are mapped.
